name: madmallard-autoswagger
description: Defensive authorized Swagger/OpenAPI endpoint exposure assessments and sensitive finding triage.

interface.defaultPrompt: Use Mad Mallard AutoSwagger for a passive review of my OpenAPI specification. Ask for explicit live scan authorization before sending requests.
interface.longDescription: Assess explicitly authorized Swagger/OpenAPI services for potentially exposed unauthenticated endpoints; triage sensitive results, verify findings, and propose remediations. Includes safe offline spec reviews. Does not include an automatic scanner execution tool.
